title: Music clips and editable vector images
summary:
New music and SVG models arrived while image routing, model estimates, and GPU limits got some practical attention.

Lyria 3 Clip adds prompt-to-music generation as a fixed 30-second MP3. Recraft V4.1 Vector adds SVG generation and editing from text or one reference image; image responses preserve the SVG, and OpenAI-compatible responses identify it with `media_type`. Both models were added to the API docs.

NanoBanana, NanoBanana 2, Lite, and Pro moved to OpenRouter while retaining their public names and existing image controls. Seedream Pro moved there too, with explicit dimensions that keep supported wide and tall 2K requests at 2K rather than promoting them to 4K. Its edits still match the reference image’s shape when no ratio is supplied. NanoBanana usage reports now combine text and reference-image prompt tokens.

Model estimates now draw from a larger stats set, bringing lower-volume models into view. Klein now rejects images above roughly 2.4 megapixels before inference and returns guidance to try smaller dimensions or fewer references if the GPU runs out of memory.

highlights.title: Lyria 3 music clips
highlights.text: Generate a 30-second MP3 from a music prompt with `lyria-3-clip` through the audio API. [Explore Lyria 3 Clip](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=lyria-3-clip).

highlights.title: Editable SVGs with Recraft
highlights.text: Use `recraft-v4.1-vector` to generate an SVG from text or edit one using a reference image. [Explore Recraft V4.1 Vector](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=recraft-v4.1-vector).

highlights.title: SVG through the image API
highlights.text: Image GET responses can return `image/svg+xml` without converting it to JPEG. OpenAI-compatible image responses include `media_type` so clients can identify SVG output. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
